name: Integration - Main Agent Loop User Interaction
description: Tests the main agent loop by simulating user input and verifying that the agent responds appropriately and exits on 'quit'.
input: Simulated user inputs: a valid message followed by 'quit'.
output: Agent prints a response to the first message and exits gracefully after 'quit'.
success_criteria: Agent prints a response to the user message
error_scenarios: Agent does not respond to user input
